Boat Capsizes in Bihar's Ganga River, 14 Children Dead

A boat carrying children capsized in the Ganga River in Bihar's Vaishali district, resulting in the deaths of 14 children. The children were reportedly on their way to attend a 'shraddh bhoj' (a ritual meal) at a relative's house. The incident has plunged the village of Rampur Shyamchand into mourning, with eyewitnesses describing the scene of the accident.
